machine_start_gcode.template:
G90 ; absolute XYZ coordinates
M83 ; relative extrusion

M204 S[machine_max_acceleration_extruding] T[machine_max_acceleration_retracting]

M104 S150 ; warm nozzle without excessive ooze
M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; start heating bed
M190 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; wait for bed to reach temperature

G28 ; home all axes
M420 S1 Z10 ; enable saved CR Touch mesh

M104 S[first_layer_temperature] ; set final nozzle temperature
M109 S[first_layer_temperature] ; wait for nozzle

G92 E0

; purge lines
G1 Z2.0 F1200
G1 X10 Y20 F3600
G1 Z0.28 F600
G1 Y180 E5.6 F900
G1 X10.5 F1800
G1 Y20 E5.6 F900

G92 E0
machine_start_gcode.now:
G90 ; absolute XYZ coordinates
M83 ; relative extrusion

M204 S[machine_max_acceleration_extruding] T[machine_max_acceleration_retracting]

M104 S150 ; warm nozzle without excessive ooze
M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; start heating bed
M190 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; wait for bed to reach temperature

G28 ; home all axes
M420 S1 ; enable saved CR Touch mesh

M104 S[first_layer_temperature] ; set final nozzle temperature
M109 S[first_layer_temperature] ; wait for nozzle

G92 E0

; purge lines - LEFT SIDE OF BED
G1 Z2.0 F1200
G1 X10 Y20 F3600
G1 Z0.28 F600
G1 Y180 E5.6 F900
G1 X10.5 F1800
G1 Y20 E5.6 F900

G92 E0

machine_end_gcode.template:
G1 E-1.0 F2100 ; small retract
G92 E0

G1{if max_layer_z < max_print_height} Z{z_offset+min(max_layer_z+10, max_print_height)}{endif} F1200 ; lift nozzle

M104 S0 ; hotend off
M140 S0 ; bed off
M107 ; fan off

G1 X0 Y105 F3000 ; park head
M84 ; disable motors
machine_end_gcode.now:
G1 E-1.0 F2100 ; retract
G92 E0.0
G1{if max_layer_z < max_print_height} Z{z_offset+min(max_layer_z+30, max_print_height)}{endif} E-34.0 F720 ; move print head up & retract filament
G4 ; wait
M104 S0 ; turn off temperature
M140 S0 ; turn off heatbed
M107 ; turn off fan
G1 X0 Y105 F3000 ; park print head
M84 ; disable motors
